provenance.author: Labib and Russo; exact Z[omega_3] certificate by @mizopl
provenance.method: exact Z[omega_3] 1-pivot quotient exclusion over the 12 symmetry orbit representatives of D_3

notes: Upgrades the m=3 bound of arXiv:2605.28586 from reproduced to verified (exact: true). Unnormalised |S> = (0, 1, -1) lies in Z^3, and all 30,240 three-qutrit stabilizer states lie in Z[omega_3]^27. Scanning the 12 symmetry pivot orbit representatives of |S>^3 in exact Z[omega_3] arithmetic shows that every collinear bucket in the second quotient Q(omega_3)^27 / span(|S>^3, s_piv) is already collinear modulo s_piv alone in Z[omega_3]^27 (dependent stabilizer triples in a 2D stabilizer subspace), with zero floating-point margins. Together with the Lean rank-4 witness this settles chi(|S>^3) = 4 at the verified/lean tier in both directions.
